name: N,N-diformylmescaline
summary: N,N-Diformylmescaline, also known as N,N-diformyl-3,4,5-trimethoxyphenethylamine, is a possible psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the N,N-diformyl derivative of mescaline. The compound has been found to be chemically unstable under acidic or basic conditions, breaking down into N-formylmescaline and then into mescaline.

pharmacology.text: Relatedly, it is thought that N,N-diformylmescaline may act as a prodrug of mescaline in vivo.

uses.text: It was encountered as a possible novel designer drug in 2020 and this was reported in 2022.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Because it may break down into mescaline, it could cause effects like those of mescaline, which include nausea, vomiting, a faster heart rate, raised blood pressure and anxiety.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。由於它可能分解成麥司卡林，因此可能產生類似麥司卡林的作用，包括噁心、嘔吐、心跳加快、血壓上升與焦慮。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。由于它可能分解成麦司卡林，因此可能产生类似麦司卡林的作用，包括恶心、呕吐、心跳加快、血压上升与焦虑。

fact.en: Its parent drug mescaline is named after the Mescalero Apache people, and it was first isolated from the peyote cactus by the German chemist Arthur Heffter in 1897.
fact.zh: 它的母體藥物麥司卡林（mescaline）得名於美洲原住民梅斯卡萊羅阿帕契族，1897 年由德國化學家亞瑟．赫夫特首次從佩奧特仙人掌中分離出來。
fact.zhHans: 它的母体药物麦司卡林（mescaline）得名于美洲原住民梅斯卡莱罗阿帕契族，1897 年由德国化学家亚瑟．赫夫特首次从佩奥特仙人掌中分离出来。
